candidate_name: Comoros offshore blocks 35-37 LNG development concept
sponsor_or_proposer: Discover Exploration (operator group) / Tullow Oil (35% farm-in, 2018) under the Comoros PSC for blocks 35, 36 & 37
current_state: Pre-discovery exploration concept only: the PSC partners flagged potential small-scale island-based LNG development in a gas-success case for the deepwater blocks outboard of the Rovuma basin; 3D seismic was acquired (~2019) but no exploration well has been drilled and no project activity was found 2020-2026. Comoros has zero gas production and no LNG infrastructure.
missing_threshold_elements: All three: no terminal sponsor (only an exploration JV's hypothetical), no site or design, no concrete terminal step. Entirely contingent on an undrilled exploration prospect; dormant ~7 years.
watch_for: An exploration well commitment/spud on blocks 35-37, a gas discovery, PSC status changes (relinquishment would kill the concept), or any LNG pre-FEED/site announcement.
notes: Both URLs verified via url_verifier.py (oilreviewafrica token 'LNG'; https://www.discover-exploration.com/news/discover-exploration-farms-out-comoros-psc-to-tullow-oil token 'Comoros').
